VAR-childmth.why: Child module records present age of the children in months (ch_age_months).

VAR-childyr.why: Roster age in years can support under-5 child age in years if needed/derivable.

VAR-marital.why: Household member roster includes Marital status (sec1a_marital_status).

VAR-relationcs.why: Household member roster includes relationship to household head (sec1a_relationship_head).
Migrant/remittance roster also includes relationship to head of household.

VAR-relationharm.why: Harmonized relationship can be derived from the country-specific relationship-to-head roster variable.
Alternate relationship-to-head variable appears in the migrant/remittance roster.

VAR-literacy.why: Education section asks reading ability (can read a letter).
Education section asks writing ability (can write a letter).

VAR-school.why: Education section asks whether currently attending school/educational institution (edu_cur_attend).

VAR-educy.why: Highest class completed can support derived years of education.
Current class attending may help derive years of education for those enrolled.

VAR-educat7.why: Highest class completed is the main source to map to highest education level completed.
Type of school/institution attended may help distinguish level categories when mapping.

VAR-educat5.why: Highest class completed can be mapped into the 5-category highest education completed target.
Type of school/institution attended may help resolve post-secondary vs tertiary.

VAR-educat4.why: Highest class completed can be aggregated into 4-category highest education completed.

VAR-primarycomp.why: Highest class completed can indicate completion of primary schooling when mapped.

VAR-eyedisability.why: Disability section asks difficulty seeing (Washington Group style severity responses).

VAR-heardisability.why: Disability section asks difficulty hearing (severity responses).

VAR-walkdisability.why: Disability section asks difficulty walking or climbing steps (severity responses).

VAR-concentrationdisorder.why: Disability section asks difficulty remembering/concentrating (severity responses).

VAR-selfcaredisability.why: Disability section asks difficulty with self care (washing/dressing) (severity responses).

VAR-communicationdisability.why: Disability section asks difficulty communicating/understanding (severity responses).

notes: Targets not routed here (e.g., agecat, language, everattend, mineducatage) did not appear in the survey index/search results and can be handled as absent/derived at authoring.
